text: The SAFER Framework provides a formalized week-one response blueprint for post-earthquake operations, emphasizing mutual aid and sustainable actions. The project employs a science-practice co-creation model, aligning with the UN Sendai Framework for disaster risk governance. It integrates scenario intensity models with infrastructure networks to identify vulnerabilities and prioritize response actions. The initiative is led by all six South Island CDEM Groups, ensuring regional consistency and shared standards.
